deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds 'that is' to explicitly define 'acetylation or deacetylation' as 'the state of transcription'. This adds a link (stating two things are the same) that the speaker did not make, as the original text presents them adjacently without explicitly conflating them.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: to the acetylation or deacetylation, the state of the transcription within the cell itself.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and to acetylation or deacetylation, that is, the state of transcription within the cell itself.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite changes the cause of chronic inflammatory events from 'they' (referring to the human viruses just mentioned) to the broader term 'infection'. This is a causal claim with a changed, wider cause.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: and they can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and infection can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events

considerations.sourcePassage: So there's a lot of changes that occur
considerations.reason: The rewrite translates the discourse marker 'So' into 'therefore' ('Many changes therefore occur'). This is acceptable as they are different words with exactly the same meaning in this context.

considerations.sourcePassage: So hopefully, in order to try and address some of these questions, we will start at the beginning. [chuckles]
considerations.reason: Dropping the chuckle and changing 'we will start' to 'the discussion starts' are acceptable adjustments to filler and stylistic grammar improvements.
